results.caption: I’m crazy enough to build a concrete arch in my house. Do you like it now?? 👀 When I shared this build a few months ago, there were over 1,300 comments asking two things: what was I going to put between the kitchen and the bar, and how was I going to style the shelves? So, I partnered with @The Home Depot again to finally finish what I started. I added a new dining table and chairs to make this awkward empty space actually feel intentional, then filled the bar with greenery, glassware and a few finishing touches that made the entire room feel warmer and more complete heading into fall. Honestly, I think the furniture and decor look way more expensive than they actually were. The Home Depot has so many stylish, on trend pieces that make it possible to get that designer look without paying the designer price. And because everything was available online with great prices, free shipping, fast delivery and easy returns, I was able to decorate the entire space without running from store to store. You already knew you could shop at The Home Depot to build your project, but now you know you can shop there to finish it too! What do you think of the final look?? #HomeDepotDecor #HomeDepotPartner

Couldn’t decide which personality was running the show, so I just let Gemini on Android choose the right track! 🤝💚
